error_codes.auth: a service key or a service-range id without a valid signature
error_codes.big: a cellular get needs more than 3 <CF> parts (ask for fewer, or "to":"con")
error_codes.cas: `b` (compare-and-set) does not match the current config hash
error_codes.cmd: unknown or not-yet-available verb (e.g. a retired v8 verb)
error_codes.err: the state file could not be written: nothing changed (send it again)
error_codes.id: id outside every sender range (console answer only)
error_codes.key: not a setting, not settable this way, or set twice (k = the name)
error_codes.lock: a locked key (file paths, commands.runtime, video_logger media): deploy only
error_codes.old: id at or below this sender range's newest id (send a newer id)
error_codes.ref: cfm of an id that nothing is waiting for
error_codes.rsd: every heal of the rsd was refused (<HL> says why)
error_codes.val: wrong type, out of range, bad charset, or JSON > 248 B (k = the key); not JSON or no usable id gets NO ack (console line only)
error_codes.xk: the resulting config breaks a cross-key or environment rule (k = a key it names)
